name: Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd
alt: Sultanate of Nejd and Kingdom of Hejaz

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Hejaz
predecessors.text: the Hejaz: 'on 19 December 1925, the Kingdom of Hejaz surrendered to the forces of Ibn Saud'; 'On January 8, 1926, he was crowned king in the Masjid al-Haram in Mecca'

predecessors.name: Third Saudi State
predecessors.text: the Sultanate of Nejd and its dependencies, from which Ibn Saud conquered the Hejaz

successors.name: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
successors.text: the whole realm: 'On 23 September 1932, Ibn Saud proclaimed the union of his dominions into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia'

rulers.name: Abdulaziz Ibn Saud (Abdul Aziz bin Abdul Rahman)
rulers.title: King of the Hejaz and Sultan (from 1927 King) of Nejd

ledger.x: 8 January 1926: Ibn Saud is crowned King of the Hejaz at Mecca and joins it to his Sultanate of Nejd.
29 January 1927: Nejd becomes a kingdom, and the realm is the Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd.
1930: Asir comes under Ibn Saud's direct control.
23 September 1932: Ibn Saud proclaims the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

wars.name: Ikhwan Revolt
wars.outcome: The rebellion, which climaxed in a battle at Sabillah, spread through Jabal Shammar in 1929 and 'was put down in 1930, with the surrender of last opposition elements'.
